title: Abort exception does not set report in standalone mode
detail: When an Abort exception is raised in standalone mode, the code re‑raises it but does not set the report variable. This means the abort message will not be printed, violating the intended behavior that an Abort should always print "Aborted!" and exit with code 1.
note: Says Abort is re-raised in standalone mode, which the planted `if standalone_mode:` does.

title: EPIPE errors silently ignored
detail: The original code handled EPIPE by pacifying flush wrappers and exiting with code 1. The new code only re-raises non‑EPIPE errors, leaving EPIPE unhandled. This can cause the program to terminate with an unhandled OSError or exit without flushing output, breaking the expected behaviour when the output pipe is closed.

title: Incorrect handling of non-ENDMARKER siblings
detail: When the sibling after the last ignored node is a leaf that is not a DEDENT or ENDMARKER, the function returns that leaf as the endmarker. The caller later treats this leaf as an ENDMARKER and inspects its prefix, which is incorrect and can lead to mis‑processing of trailing comments or blank lines.
note: Describes the planted flip: a leaf that isn't the end marker is returned as one.

title: Incorrect logical operator in blank line condition
detail: The condition uses `or` instead of `and`, causing a blank line to be printed even when the console is interactive but not jupyter, which is not intended.
note: Says the blank line is printed when either holds, which the planted `or` does.

title: Incorrect lock status check
detail: DeferredLock exposes a `locked()` method, not a `locked` attribute. Accessing `self._export_lock.locked` raises an AttributeError, breaking the export flow.

title: Incorrect logic in accept_html property
detail: The property is documented to return True when `text/html` is accepted, but the code returns True when it is *not* present, causing callers to receive the opposite result.
note: Says accept_html is true when text/html is absent, which the planted `not in` does.
